comparison.objective: Place a weighted tube end into the designated waste bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable tube handling, opening alignment, insertion-depth control, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Weighted end rests at least 3 cm below the WASTE bottle rim and never enters another bottle.
comparison.reason: Flexible-tube insertion into a container differs from rigid coaxial tooling, bimanual impact, fracture validation, and debris collection.
